signin.solo-notice: Sign in to your firm to activate a seat and collaborate on shared clients. Solo use needs no account and stays fully local.

claim.heading: Claim your firm
claim.description: I received a license key from LemonSqueezy after purchasing. I'll use it to create my admin account and activate my firm.
claim.error-already-claimed: This license key has already been claimed. Sign in with your existing account.
claim.error-not-found: I don't recognize that license key. Check the email from LemonSqueezy and try again.
claim.success-heading: Firm claimed. Activate your seat next.
claim.success-hint: I've pre-filled your license key. Enter a label for this device and click Activate seat.

admin.title: Firm console
admin.not-admin: The firm console is available to administrators. Ask your firm admin to create clients and manage seats.
admin.invite-new-user-hint: This email is not in your org yet. I'll create their account and show you a temporary password to share.
admin.temp-password-hint: This is shown once. Copy and share it with {{email}} directly.
admin.assured-description: Store a managed provider key so members can use the Assured (zero-retention proxy) confidentiality mode. The key is encrypted at rest on the server and never shown again.
admin.republish-keys-action: Re-publish keys to all member devices
admin.republish-keys-ok: Keys sent to all registered devices.
admin.invite-user-exists: {{email}} already has an account. Use the admin console to add them, or ask them to accept an invitation.
admin.wall-user-not-found: No user ID found for {{email}}. Invite them first so their ID is cached.
admin.auto-republish-ok: Granted key access to newly registered devices for {{count}} client(s).

sso.description: Let firm members sign in through your organization's identity provider. Register this application with your IdP using the Redirect URI below, then enter the credentials your IdP gives you.
sso.redirect-uri-hint: Paste this URI into your IdP when registering the application.
sso.provider-hint-entra: Register in Azure portal → App registrations → Redirect URIs.
sso.provider-hint-google: Register in Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials.
sso.provider-hint-generic: Register the redirect URI with your OIDC-compatible identity provider.
sso.secret-saved-hint: Secret saved. Leave blank to keep the existing secret.

carry.heading: Bring your clients into the firm
carry.intro: For each client, choose to leave it private (stays just on your computer) or share it with the firm so colleagues can collaborate. Sharing moves the shared notes and any documents you co-edit, all encrypted. Your files, email, and search index stay on your computer.
carry.empty: You have no clients to bring over yet. You can share any client later from the client screen.
carry.privileged-confirm-body: Sharing turns on encrypted internet sync for this privileged client so colleagues can collaborate. The relay only ever stores encrypted data it cannot read. Continue?

bridge.heading: Use {{productName}} with your firm
bridge.intro: Pick how you want to get into a firm. Then you can bring your existing clients over, choosing for each one whether to keep it private or share it with colleagues.
bridge.door-create-body: You become the admin and the first seat. Invite colleagues, share clients, set up single sign-on and the firm security.
bridge.door-join-body: Sign in to a firm that already exists and claim your seat. An admin sets you up first.
bridge.create-paid-note: The firm plan is a paid plan, separate from your solo license. Get it here, then claim your firm below:

prompt.title: Use {{productName}} with your firm
prompt.body: Bring colleagues in and share clients, or join a firm that already uses {{productName}}. Your private clients stay private.
